name: [Open Test] World Sail
desc:
Legacy Piece is an open world RPG game inspired by the anime One Piece. This game is not the complete version, so please expect bugs and glitches!

Power Core Abilities spawn once every 30 minutes and de-spawn after 15 minutes!

Chests spawn every 15 minutes!

Basic Controls:
M1 = Combat
E = Evade (When being attacked)
Z,X,C,V,G = Ability Skills (If unlocked)
Left Ctrl = Run
B = Enhancement (If unlocked)
H = Conqueror Spirit (If bought)(Or 5/100chance to get on first life)
N = Observation

Current Abilities:
- Barrier
- Fire
- Light
- Quake
- Dark
- Sand
- Ice
- Bomb
- Lightning
- Invisibility
- Mochi
- Magma
- Operation
- Paw
- Dragon [WIP]
- Rubber
- Smoke
- Love
- Chop
- Gravity
